svg.title: K values at 20 °C: 1000 kPa (and the printed 100 kPa)
svg.text: K values at 20 °C: 1000 kPa (and the printed 100 kPa)
High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark p = 1000 kPa on the pressure scale (left).
Mark T = 20 °C on the temperature scale (right).
Join the two marks (dashed: the printed 100 kPa gives K > 1 for all three).
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
